game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Bat Hollow.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 9: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for C origins.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
